question.problem:
What is the minor of ${u}_{21}$ in the matrix
$U=[\begin{aligned}-4 & j & k-2j \\ kj & j & k \\ 7 & -k & j\end{aligned}]?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we remove the second row and the first column: 

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}∗ & j & k-2j \\ kj & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & -k & j\end{aligned}]
$$

Next, we calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}j & k-2j \\ -k & j\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}j & k-2j \\ -k & j\end{aligned}| \\  & =j\cdot j-(-k)\cdot (k-2j) \\  & ={j}^{2}+k(k-2j) \\  & ={j}^{2}+{k}^{2}-k2j \\  & ={j}^{2}-2jk+{k}^{2} \\  & =(j-k)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
